text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--A Beirut prosecutor charged five Japanese Red Army suspects with passport forgery and other offences.
--Cargo carrier Trans Mediterranean Airlines increased its capital by 60 billion Lebanese pounds ($39 million).
--France warned that fighting between Moslem guerrillas and Israeli troops in south Lebanon could worsen if Middle East peace talks were not revived immediately.

--Parliament Speaker Berri: Let us not forget the massacres and our detainees in Israeli prisons. Let us work hand in hand with Arabs and other friends to push for the implementation of U.N. Security Council resolution 425.
--Lebanese man Ali Adre is the world's oldest person at 135.
--Lebanon will hold a new tender for the purchase of 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat on international markets next week.
--Maronite Patriarch Sfeir in Brazil: Lebanon will not die. It will regain its independence.
